title: Memory Not Passed as Chat History in Tool Calling Agent
body:
### Bug Description

Although the memories are being recorded correctly, they are not being correctly passed as chat history to the agent.

### Reproduction

1. Use the tool calling agent with memory in version 1.0.11 pip.
2. Record some memories using the tool.
3. Attempt to pass the recorded memories as chat history to the agent.
A video demonstrating the issue can be found here: https://jam.dev/c/c7b6d3f6-7151-47a8-89c4-047e04c0aeba

### Expected behavior

The recorded memories should be correctly passed as chat history to the agent.

### Who can help?

@nicoloboschi 

### Operating System

Ubuntu Linux 22.04

### Langflow Version

1.0.11

### Python Version

3.10

linked_prs.title: fix: tool calling and openai tools do not include chat history

ai_judgment.response: Yes. This issue involves memory-related symptoms, specifically the failure to pass recorded memories as chat history to the agent, which aligns with the "Memory content errors" sub-category under the taxonomy of agent issues.
